title: 12 第十二章
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

在都竞华的观念里，准时进学校就相当于没迟到，至于什么时候能从大门跑到教学楼……作为一个没有校内驾驶资格的普通学生，都竞华觉得校方应该能体谅自己行动速度有限。

五分钟后，都竞华快步走进了E区7栋909教室。

七栋这边以小教室为主，很多年都没修过了，看着像是上个世纪遗留下来的老建筑，遗迹学的学生们还怀疑过，自己的毕业课题是不是就是将这玩意给拆了……

都竞华来得不算早，动作小心地推开教室后门，十分丝滑地出溜到了一个空位上落座，同时侧过身，悄声询问旁边的同学：“知道喊我们过来什么事吗？”

正巧坐在边上的同学范洛杉摇头：“聊一早上了，谁都不清楚。”又道，“不过那么多人都回来了，我觉得不会是什么太严重的事，假期工作涉及到的学分问题肯定会处理的。”

前排的赵大力转过身：“说不定是有校领导落马，进而牵扯到了我们。”

周西露出惊喜的神色：“有可靠的信息来源吗？”

赵大力低头羞涩一笑：“我就是畅想一下。”

都竞华：“还在学校，大家聊天时记得对心理活动进行符合大学生精神风貌的调整。”

边上的连西洲环视一圈，目光落在都竞华脸上，看了两秒钟，道：“今天黑眼圈有点重。”

都竞华懒懒道：“我昨天白天还在忙遗迹那边的事，晚上又参加了聚餐。”

话中的每一个字都是真的，至于晚上是否熬夜以及熬夜时又做了什么，显然属于可以忽略的部分。

都竞华跟往常一样，与同学随意说笑，尽量不让自己表现得跟以前差别太大。

而且过往经验告诉都竞华，有必须隐瞒的秘密时，反而不要说太多谎。

——谎言需要用在刀刃上才能起到最佳效果，属于个人的声望并非仅存在于游戏中，日常尽量不要给旁人留下太过负面的印象。

连西洲语气里带了点抱怨：“大家好像都不想跑这一趟。”

都竞华笑：“基于对学校做事风格的了解，大家自然会对临时出现的返校要求的必要性做出正确的判断。”

自由大学这个名字经常作为黑称出现在被严格管束的学生口中。

由于都竞华说话的语速有点快，连西洲顿了片刻，才用笃定的语气道：“你刚刚一定是在讽刺什么。”

等到九点半，临时得到通知的学生们总算集齐，而直到十点半，导员才姗姗来迟。

导员看过因为久坐而逐渐不耐的学生后，说了句“稍等”就很有自由大学风格地再次消失。

学生们咕哝了几句“我就知道”、“果不其然”、“下次过一个小时再来”。

范洛杉吐槽：“说九点开会，最后一定是十点以后才开始，我今早就不该多花钱约飞车的。”

她的语气里还带着深深的肉痛感。

都竞华做了个“嘘”的手势，满脸认真：“千万别让他们知道我们已经发现了，不然下次开会时，我担心大家会收到提前两小时抵达目的地的通知。”

周围同学们严肃点头。

作为班长的路晨翼一副什么也没听到的模样，脸上依旧挂着好学生的微笑。

半个小时后，路晨翼接到召唤离开，从导员那边拿了一叠调查问卷准备发给同学们。

赶了一个多小时路才抵达学校的霍飞冬满脸震惊：“什么问卷还要大家亲自跑到学校填？我以为学校应该知道班级群里就有自带的问卷功能。”

从赤河中路坐空轨千里迢迢赶过来的都竞华友情科普：“你解决问题的方式太现代了，根据记录，三百年前的通讯器就已经支持谈话功能了，那个时候还叫手机。”

其他人闻言顿时觉得都竞华科技史学得还真不错。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

In Du Jinghua's view, entering school on time is equivalent to not being late. As for when he can run from the gate to the teaching building... As an ordinary student who does not have the qualification to drive on campus, Du Jinghua feels that the school should be considerate of his limited movement speed.

Five minutes later, Du Jinghua quickly walked into Classroom 909, Building 7, Area E.

The seventh building is mainly composed of small classrooms. It has not been repaired for many years. It looks like an old building left over from the last century. The students of heritage studies also doubted whether this thing was demolished for their graduation project...

Du Jinghua arrived not too early. He carefully pushed open the back door of the classroom, slipped out very smoothly and sat down in an empty seat. At the same time, he turned sideways and quietly asked the classmates next to him: "Do you know why you are calling us here?"

Fan Luoshan, a classmate who happened to be sitting next to him, shook his head: "We've been chatting all morning, and no one knows." He added, "But so many people have come back, I don't think it will be a serious matter. The credit issue related to the holiday work will definitely be dealt with."

Zhao Dali, who was in the front row, turned around and said, "Perhaps some school leaders were dismissed, which in turn implicated us."

Zhou west looked surprised: "Is there a reliable source of information?"

Zhao Dali lowered his head and smiled shyly: "I just want to think about it."

Du Jinghua: "While we are still in school, when chatting, remember to adjust your mental activities in line with the spiritual outlook of college students."

Lian Xizhou on the side looked around, his eyes fell on Du Jinghua's face, looked at him for two seconds, and said: "The dark circles under my eyes are a bit heavy today."

Du Jinghua said lazily: "I was still busy with the ruins during the day yesterday, and attended a dinner party in the evening."

Every word in the words is true. As for whether he stayed up late at night and what he did when he stayed up late, it is obviously a part that can be ignored.

Du Jinghua was chatting and joking with his classmates as usual, trying not to behave too differently from before.

Moreover, past experience has taught Du Jinghua that when there are secrets that must be concealed, don't tell too many lies.

——Lies need to be used on the edge to achieve the best results. Personal reputation does not only exist in the game. Try not to leave too negative an impression on others in daily life.

Lian Xizhou said with a hint of complaint in his tone: "No one seems to want to make this trip."

Du Jinghua laughed: "Based on the understanding of the school's work style, everyone will naturally make a correct judgment on the necessity of temporary return to school requirements."

The name Liberty University often appears as a nickname among strictly disciplined students.

Because Du Jinghua spoke a bit fast, Lian Xizhou paused for a moment before saying in a determined tone: "You must have been sarcastic about something just now."

By 9:30, the students who had been notified at short notice finally gathered, and it was not until 10:30 that the instructor was late.

After seeing the students who were becoming impatient due to sitting for too long, the instructor said "Wait a moment" and disappeared again in a liberal university style.

The students muttered a few words, "I knew it," "As expected," and "Come back in an hour next time."

Fan Luoshan complained: "I said I would have a meeting at nine o'clock, but it must not start until after ten o'clock. I shouldn't have spent extra money to arrange a ride this morning."

There was a deep sense of pain in her tone.

Du Jinghua made a "shh" gesture with a serious face: "Don't let them know that we have discovered it, otherwise when the next meeting is held, I am worried that everyone will receive a two-hour notice to arrive at the destination."

The students around him nodded seriously.

As the monitor, Lu Chenyi looked like he hadn't heard anything, and still had the smile of a good student on his face.

Half an hour later, Lu Chenyi received the call and left. He took a stack of questionnaires from the instructor and prepared to distribute them to the students.

Huo Feidong, who had traveled for more than an hour to arrive at the school, was shocked: "Why should everyone go to school to fill out the questionnaire in person? I thought the school should know that the class group has its own questionnaire function."

Du Jinghua, who came all the way from Chihe Middle Road by skytrain, said: "Your way of solving problems is too modern. According to records, communicators three hundred years ago already supported the conversation function. At that time, they were still called mobile phones."

When others heard this, they immediately felt that Du Jinghua was really good at studying the history of science and technology.
